timeline.text: Welcome to Missing a Friendship That Faded. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I miss a friendship that isn’t what it used to be.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep thinking about how things used to feel.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m not sure what happened between us.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice the distance every time I think of them.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels a quiet sadness about this.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish I could go back to how it was.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me wonders if I did something wrong.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this loss is real, even without an ending.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This kind of fading is its own kind of hard.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can grieve this without needing a clear reason.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: People and friendships change, and that isn’t always about fault.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can hold the good memories without needing them back.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t have to solve what happened to move forward.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften around this sadness.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to miss someone and still be okay.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This doesn’t mean I’m hard to love.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can make room for new connection too.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this friendship be part of my story, even now.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust that meaningful connection is still ahead of me.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can carry the good parts of this friendship with gratitude.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to reach out, or to let it be.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can see this clearly without judging myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel at peace with this chapter.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m capable of building new closeness.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This ending doesn’t diminish what it once was.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can honor this friendship by moving forward gently.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to make peace with this.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
